## Ctx.handleCommandCaptionArgsPhoto() method

Route function for photoCaptionCommandPayload with slash command and arg match intent `this.data.name`

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleCommandCaptionArgsPhoto?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by photo with caption command and args.
